name: 1926-singlestream-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, hidden 4096, 32 query and 32 KV heads, fp16, 4096-token window; 6.7B parameters, ~13.5 GB of weights. The rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 1, warmup 10%, no cooldown, bounded at 200 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, static seed 914. Prompt EXACTLY 32 tokens and output EXACTLY 128 (min = max on both, zero dispersion), greedy (`temperature: 0.0`) with `ignore_eos`, so every request generates exactly 128 tokens. The prompt is tokenized with add_special_tokens=True, so the engine counts and reports a token or two more than 32.
purpose: A single-user writing assistant on one GPU, where a 7B model turns brief prompts into 128-token replies.
launch:
# vLLM 0.2.5-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM.
#
# Flat reader: `key: value` lines only. An indented YAML block never reaches AsyncEngineArgs;
# a value beginning `{` or `[` is read as JSON and must stay on one line.

model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-hf
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-batched-tokens: 4096
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
